title: 第146章 偶像太争气
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

广场上，兄弟团们和五百位粉丝一起合唱着。

阳光从塔身的琉璃瓦上倾泻下来，落在每一个仰头唱歌的人脸上。

“你说我是你的超级英雄，偶尔也客串你的出气筒，心甘情愿接受这份光荣，做你身边的萤火虫啊哦啊……”

副歌响起来的时候。

有人哭了，有人笑了。

邓朝把麦克风转向粉丝的方向，五百个声音异口同声的唱着。

不需要伴奏，不需要提词器。

李辰没有再扭过头去，他的眼泪顺着脸颊往下淌，但他没有再擦。

Baby和迪丽热八靠在一起，两个女生的声线在副歌里轻轻交织。

王祖兰仰着头，用尽全身力气把每一个字都唱得又响又亮。

鹿寒站在郑凯旁边，他的声音依旧不大，但此刻没有人在意音量。

“如果我是你的超级英雄，此刻为你高唱这首LOveSOng，小小的默契让爱转动，做你最骄傲的英雄！”

最后一个尾音落下，没有掌声，没有欢呼。

只有雷峰塔的风从西湖上吹过来，轻轻拂过每一个人的头发。

邓朝站在最前面，缓缓放下麦克风，看着面前这五百位粉丝。

他的眼睛还是红的，但脸上全是笑容。

一种很温暖的笑。

吴凡站在雷峰塔前，背对着那面已经停止滚动画面的大屏幕。

眼睛也有开始控制不住了。

这个全体大合唱的歌，远比在录音室里录下来的音频更加震撼！

也更有感染力！

吴凡用手背飞快地抹了一把眼角。

深吸一口气，强迫自己从刚才那场集体泪崩中抽离出来。

他是导演，是这个新闻发布会的总控。

所有人都可以哭……

当然他也可以哭。

只是他哭完之后，还得把这场发布会稳稳当当地收尾。

“大家唱的非常好！我也非常感谢今天五百位粉丝的到来！”

吴凡的声音还带着一丝沙哑，语速已经恢复了平时的沉稳，“你们是无数跑男粉丝的代表，所以今天的你们是幸运的！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the square, the brothers sang together with 500 fans.

The sunlight poured down from the glazed tiles of the tower and fell on the faces of everyone who raised their heads and sang.

"You said that I am your superhero and occasionally your punching bag. I am willing to accept this honor and be the firefly beside you..."

When the chorus sounds.

Some people cried, some people laughed.

Deng Chao turned the microphone in the direction of the fans, and five hundred voices sang in unison.

No accompaniment required, no teleprompter required.

Li Chen didn't turn his head anymore. Tears flowed down his cheeks, but he didn't wipe them away.

Baby and Dilireba leaned together, and the two girls’ voices gently intertwined in the chorus.

Wang Zulan raised her head and sang every word loudly and loudly with all her strength.

Lu Han stood next to Zheng Kai. His voice was still not loud, but no one cared about the volume at the moment.

"If I were your superhero, I would sing this song LOveSong for you right now. A small tacit understanding will make love turn, and I will be your proudest hero!"

When the last note fell, there was no applause or cheers.

Only the wind from Leifeng Pagoda blew from the West Lake, gently brushing everyone's hair.

Deng Chao stood at the front, slowly put down the microphone, and looked at the five hundred fans in front of him.

His eyes were still red, but there was a smile on his face.

A very warm smile.

Wu Fan stood in front of Leifeng Pagoda, with his back to the big screen that had stopped scrolling.

I also started to lose control of my eyes.

This chorus of songs is far more shocking than the audio recorded in the studio!

It’s also more contagious!

Wu Fan quickly wiped the corners of his eyes with the back of his hand.

Taking a deep breath, he forced himself to escape from the collective burst of tears just now.

He is the director and the overall controller of this press conference.

Everyone can cry...

Of course he can cry too.

But after he finished crying, he still had to end the press conference safely.

"Everyone sang very well! I am also very grateful to the 500 fans who came today!"

Wu Fan's voice was still a little hoarse, but his speaking speed had returned to his usual calmness, "You are the representatives of countless Running Man fans, so you are lucky today!
